metadata.description: THINK School Growth Team: Capture and Proposal Managed Team plugins for AI-native pursuit work. Bring your own organizational data and approve decisions and deliverables.

plugins.name: proposal-team
plugins.description: Delivers a submission-ready proposal: the research, positioning, drafting, and QA work you're too busy to get to, done by a Managed Team of seven Digital Employees -- Maya (lead), Chase, Priya, Porter, Quinn, Diego, Blair -- plus a separate grant/funder track. Bring your own pricing, case studies, and brand guidelines.

plugins.name: capture-team
plugins.description: Delivers a decision-ready Capture Brief: the opportunity research and qualification work you're too busy to get to, done by a Managed Team of three Digital Employees. Chet discovers, Kipp qualifies, and Ben delivers the brief. Bring your own criteria, CRM, and opportunity sources.
